subject: SOC 2 audit window confirmation + request for select auth extracts (JunoHealth)
messages:
From: Samira Roy <samira.roy@junohealth.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: JunoHealth Security <security@junohealth.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 audit window + targeted artifact asks

Jonas —

Quick one as we're scoping the upcoming SOC 2 Type II review: our auditor asked us to confirm Redwood's audit period and provide a couple of specific control artifacts in addition to the SOC 2 report and cover letter. Can you confirm which audit period your last Type II covers (start/end dates) and whether you can provide the following artifacts scoped to that window?

- MFA enforcement evidence (enforcement policy + timestamped enforcement logs showing enforcement date)
- Authentication log extract for a 7-day sample window within the audit period (timestamped, minimally redacted: user id, source IP, timestamp, auth_result)
- Evidence of quarterly access review completion for the past year (review owner, date, summary)
- Service-account inventory export (names, scopes, last-rotated date)

We are fine with CSV/CSV+PDF attachments. The auditor requested these items by next Tuesday (2027-06-22) if possible. If you prefer, we can accept a signed bridge letter noting audit coverage for the same window + an ETA for the extracts.

Thanks — we appreciate the quick turnaround.

Samira Roy
Director, Information Security
JunoHealth

Attachment: (none in this message)

From: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Samira Roy <samira.roy@junohealth.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 audit window + targeted artifact asks

Samira —

Thanks for the heads up. Our most recent SOC 2 Type II covers 2026-07-01 through 2027-06-30 (period end is 2027-06-30). We can provide a bridge letter confirming coverage through that date and we can also produce the targeted artifacts you listed.

Quick internal plan: Monica, can you pull the MFA enforcement proof and a 7-day auth extract from within the audit period (please target any week in March 2027 unless auditor requests otherwise)? Vivek — please compile the quarterly access review summaries and service-account export; combine into a single package we can deliver securely.

Samira, we aim to deliver the bridge letter + auth_extract_sample.csv and access_review_summary.pdf by Monday EOD PST (2027-06-21). If the auditor needs a different sample week, let us know and we'll adjust.

Jonas
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: bridge-letter-draft.pdf (draft, redwood internal)
